s0501.literal: On gengxu day Ashibo was dispatched to sacrifice to the household deity at the northern mobile encampment.
s0501.idiomatic: On gengxu day Ashibo was dispatched to sacrifice to the household deity at the northern mobile encampment.

s0502.literal: On jiayin day envoys were dispatched bearing an edict to instruct separately the Yao tribes; Ninai, native official of Zhenkang Route, and Saiqiuluo, native official of Mounian Route, came out to surrender;
s0502.idiomatic: On jiayin day envoys were dispatched bearing an edict to instruct separately the Yao tribes; Ninai, native official of Zhenkang Route, and Saiqiuluo, native official of Mounian Route, came out to surrender;

s0503.literal: Bamiao, native official of Mobang Route, having submitted then rebelled again.
s0503.idiomatic: Bamiao, native official of Mobang Route, having submitted then rebelled again.

s0504.literal: A comet appeared at the Directorate of Astronomy at Shangdu.
s0504.idiomatic: A comet appeared at the Directorate of Astronomy at Shangdu.

s0505.literal: Niuzhe and Xu Shijing completed compiling and arranging the "Imperial Instructions"; they requested to present lectures at the Classics Colloquium and also have the crown prince read them; an edict directed that the book be translated and submitted.
s0505.idiomatic: Niuzhe and Xu Shijing completed compiling and arranging the "Imperial Instructions"; they requested to present lectures at the Classics Colloquium and also have the crown prince read them; an edict directed that the book be translated and submitted.

s0506.literal: On bingchen day sacrifices were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0506.idiomatic: On bingchen day sacrifices were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0507.literal: Bozhou Yao Ping'ai and others gathered tribal bands to raid; the Huguang Branch Secretariat requested troops to suppress them — denied; an edict directed Bozhou Pacification Commissioner Yang Yelibuhua to summon and instruct them.
s0507.idiomatic: Bozhou Yao Ping'ai and others gathered tribal bands to raid; the Huguang Branch Secretariat requested troops to suppress them — denied; an edict directed Bozhou Pacification Commissioner Yang Yelibuhua to summon and instruct them.

s0508.literal: On wuwu day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice by proxy at the two mountains Longhu and Wudang.
s0508.idiomatic: On wuwu day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice by proxy at the two mountains Longhu and Wudang.

s0509.literal: On jiwei day the Cheli Military-Civilian General Pacification Office was established, with the native Han Sai as commissioner bearing a gold tiger tally.
s0509.idiomatic: On jiwei day the Cheli Military-Civilian General Pacification Office was established, with the native Han Sai as commissioner bearing a gold tiger tally.

s0510.literal: Central Secretariat ministers said, "In past years when campaigning against the Yao, the surveillance commission impeached troops for indiscriminate killing; hereafter whenever troops are dispatched, one surveillance commission official should accompany the army to rectify matters.
s0510.idiomatic: Central Secretariat ministers said, "In past years when campaigning against the Yao, the surveillance commission impeached troops for indiscriminate killing; hereafter whenever troops are dispatched, one surveillance commission official should accompany the army to rectify matters.

s0512.literal: On gengshen day two palace women were granted to Prince Qiebie.
s0512.idiomatic: On gengshen day two palace women were granted to Prince Qiebie.

s0513.literal: On guihai day Dagan Yuan Temple was repaired.
s0513.idiomatic: On guihai day Dagan Yuan Temple was repaired.

s0514.literal: Xu Shijing and bureau director Mai Lü were additionally appointed Classics Colloquium officials.
s0514.idiomatic: Xu Shijing and bureau director Mai Lü were additionally appointed Classics Colloquium officials.

s0515.literal: Guangxi Yao tribes raided walled cities; Left Vice Director of the Huguang Branch Secretariat Qizhu, Minister of War Li Dacheng, and Secretariat drafter Mai Lü were dispatched leading twenty-two thousand troops to suppress them, with Prince Ordoe'erhan overseeing the army.
s0515.idiomatic: Guangxi Yao tribes raided walled cities; Left Vice Director of the Huguang Branch Secretariat Qizhu, Minister of War Li Dacheng, and Secretariat drafter Mai Lü were dispatched leading 22,000 troops to suppress them, with Prince Ordoe'erhan overseeing the army.

s0516.literal: Haibei Yao chieftain Pan Jixiang raided Yangchun County; the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to supervise troops in capturing them.
s0516.idiomatic: Haibei Yao chieftain Pan Jixiang raided Yangchun County; the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat was ordered to supervise troops in capturing them.

s0517.literal: On gengwu day, because state revenue was insufficient, the copying in gold characters of the Buddhist canon was abolished.
s0517.idiomatic: On gengwu day, because state revenue was insufficient, the copying in gold characters of the Buddhist canon was abolished.

s0518.literal: Weichu and Dali various tribes raided; the Yunnan Branch Secretariat requested dispatch of troops — denied; Yilimadan et al. were sent as envoys to Dali, Puyanshili et al. to Weichu, to summon and instruct them.
s0518.idiomatic: Weichu and Dali various tribes raided; the Yunnan Branch Secretariat requested dispatch of troops — denied; Yilimadan et al. were sent as envoys to Dali, Puyanshili et al. to Weichu, to summon and instruct them.

s0519.literal: Sizhou cave tribes Yang Yinqian et al. came to offer local products.
s0519.idiomatic: Sizhou cave tribes Yang Yinqian et al. came to offer local products.

s0520.literal: Imperial son-in-law Bolu Temür and privy council vice director Huosha were both enfeoffed as princes of a commandery.
s0520.idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Bolu Temür and privy council vice director Huosha were both enfeoffed as princes of a commandery.

s0521.literal: On xinwei day the Henan Branch Directorate of Waterways was established.
s0521.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Henan Branch Directorate of Waterways was established.

s0522.literal: It was proclaimed that Han people were forbidden to keep or possess weapons; those with military registration would be issued them on campaign and, upon return, they would revert to the government.
s0522.idiomatic: It was proclaimed that Han people were forbidden to keep or possess weapons; those with military registration would be issued them on campaign and, upon return, they would revert to the government.

s0523.literal: On renshen day censorate ministers said, "Surveillance commission officials accompanying armies is not the old system of Shizu.
s0523.idiomatic: On renshen day censorate ministers said, "Surveillance commission officials accompanying armies is not the old system of Shizu.

s0524.literal: Muslim merchants selling gems, Western monks performing Buddhist rites — the expenses are unsustainable and benefit the state not at all; all should be abolished.
s0524.idiomatic: Muslim merchants selling gems, Western monks performing Buddhist rites — the expenses are unsustainable and benefit the state not at all; all should be abolished.

s0526.literal: An edict directed Grand Preceptor Duotai and Grand Guardian Tuhulu to assemble daily within the Forbidden City to deliberate state affairs.
s0526.idiomatic: An edict directed Grand Preceptor Duotai and Grand Guardian Tuhulu to assemble daily within the Forbidden City to deliberate state affairs.

s0527.literal: Yao tribesman Pan Bao raided Tanjin, Yining, Laibin and other counties; Guangxi garrison commanders were ordered to capture him.
s0527.idiomatic: Yao tribesman Pan Bao raided Tanjin, Yining, Laibin and other counties; Guangxi garrison commanders were ordered to capture him.

s0528.literal: Qingyuan stream-cave people suffered famine; twenty thousand five hundred shi of grain was issued and sold at fair price.
s0528.idiomatic: Qingyuan stream-cave people suffered famine; 20,500 shi of grain was issued and sold at fair price.

s0529.literal: An edict directed Shandong prefectures and counties to take in abandoned children of displaced people.
s0529.idiomatic: An edict directed Shandong prefectures and counties to take in abandoned children of displaced people.

s0530.literal: Yan'an, Fuzhou, Suide, Gongchang and other places had hail; Panyang Xincheng County had locusts; Zongren Guard garrison-farm fields were killed by frost; Suizhou's river burst its banks; Shunde, Bianliang, De'an, Runing and other circuits suffered drought; their rent was remitted.
s0530.idiomatic: Yan'an, Fuzhou, Suide, Gongchang and other places had hail; Panyang Xincheng County had locusts; Zongren Guard garrison-farm fields were killed by frost; Suizhou's river burst its banks; Shunde, Bianliang, De'an, Runing and other circuits suffered drought; their rent was remitted.

s0531.literal: Meizhou, Raozhou, Zhenjiang, Binzhou and other circuits suffered famine; more than thirty thousand shi of grain was released for relief at reduced price.
s0531.idiomatic: Meizhou, Raozhou, Zhenjiang, Binzhou and other circuits suffered famine; more than 30,000 shi of grain was released for relief at reduced price.

s0532.literal: Eighth month, on wuzi day, the Fragrance Hall at Shangdu was repaired.
s0532.idiomatic: Eighth month, on wuzi day, the Fragrance Hall at Shangdu was repaired.

s0533.literal: On xinmao day Yunnan Bai tribes raided Yunlong Prefecture.
s0533.idiomatic: On xinmao day Yunnan Bai tribes raided Yunlong Prefecture.

s0534.literal: On guisi day Jupiter transgressed Tianzun.
s0534.idiomatic: On guisi day Jupiter transgressed Tianzun.

s0535.literal: On xinchou day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice by proxy at the famous mountains and rivers of the Four Sacred Peaks and great waterways.
s0535.idiomatic: On xinchou day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice by proxy at the famous mountains and rivers of the Four Sacred Peaks and great waterways.

s0536.literal: An edict directed, "Princes who enter the capital privately — do not supply their needs;
s0536.idiomatic: An edict directed, "Princes who enter the capital privately — do not supply their needs;

s0537.literal: private retainers and household guards who enter the capital privately shall be punished.
s0537.idiomatic: private retainers and household guards who enter the capital privately shall be punished.

s0538.literal: " An order directed the Revenue Commissariat to cull the camels and horses under Atachi's charge and keep them in outer prefectures.
s0538.idiomatic: An order directed the Revenue Commissariat to cull the camels and horses under Atachi's charge and keep them in outer prefectures.

s0539.literal: Tanchou of Dadu Circuit, Jingning County of Gongchang Prefecture, Ansai County of Yan'an Circuit had hail; Jixian of Weihui Circuit had river overflow.
s0539.idiomatic: Tanchou of Dadu Circuit, Jingning County of Gongchang Prefecture, Ansai County of Yan'an Circuit had hail; Jixian of Weihui Circuit had river overflow.

s0540.literal: Nan'en Prefecture and Qiongzhou suffered famine; one month's grain was granted in relief.
s0540.idiomatic: Nan'en Prefecture and Qiongzhou suffered famine; 1 month's grain was granted in relief.

s0541.literal: Linjiang Circuit and Guide Prefecture suffered famine; two months' grain was granted in relief.
s0541.idiomatic: Linjiang Circuit and Guide Prefecture suffered famine; 2 months' grain was granted in relief.

s0542.literal: Hengzhou, Jianchang, and Yuezhou suffered famine; thirteen thousand shi of grain was released for relief at reduced price.
s0542.idiomatic: Hengzhou, Jianchang, and Yuezhou suffered famine; 13,000 shi of grain was released for relief at reduced price.

s0543.literal: Ninth month, on wushen new moon, the realm was divided into eighteen circuits and envoys were dispatched as pacification commissioners.
s0543.idiomatic: Ninth month, on wushen new moon, the realm was divided into 18 circuits and envoys were dispatched as pacification commissioners.

s0544.literal: An edict said, "We reverently receive the great enterprise, rising early and retiring late with diligence; in all we do to govern, we wholly follow the established statutes of our ancestors.
s0544.idiomatic: An edict said, "We reverently receive the great enterprise, rising early and retiring late with diligence; in all we do to govern, we wholly follow the established statutes of our ancestors.

s0545.literal: Long have We repeatedly issued edicts to the hundred offices within and without, proclaiming benevolent grace, remitting taxes and reviewing punishments, relieving and succoring the poor — seeking to share with the common folk the joy of living.
s0545.idiomatic: Long have We repeatedly issued edicts to the hundred offices within and without, proclaiming benevolent grace, remitting taxes and reviewing punishments, relieving and succoring the poor — seeking to share with the common folk the joy of living.

s0546.literal: Yet We still fear officials may not embody Our intent; common governance may be deficient and gracious benefits not fully extended; those bearing proclamations may fail in placating and comforting, while surveillance officers slacken in investigation — causing Our people renewed hardship, which We deeply pity.
s0546.idiomatic: Yet We still fear officials may not embody Our intent; common governance may be deficient and gracious benefits not fully extended; those bearing proclamations may fail in placating and comforting, while surveillance officers slacken in investigation — causing Our people renewed hardship, which We deeply pity.

s0547.literal: We now dispatch pacification commissioners to proceed separately to the various circuits, to inquire into unlawful officials, investigate the people's hardships, examine and resolve unjust and stagnant cases — whatever may benefit the realm and remove harm shall be carried out as appropriate.
s0547.idiomatic: We now dispatch pacification commissioners to proceed separately to the various circuits, to inquire into unlawful officials, investigate the people's hardships, examine and resolve unjust and stagnant cases — whatever may benefit the realm and remove harm shall be carried out as appropriate.

s0548.literal: Those guilty: officials of rank 4a and above shall be suspended from office pending memorial; those of rank 5b and below may be dealt with on the spot.
s0548.idiomatic: Those guilty: officials of rank 4a and above shall be suspended from office pending memorial; those of rank 5b and below may be dealt with on the spot.

s0549.literal: Those with especially distinguished achievements, as well as recluses hidden in hills and gardens whose talent is fit to assist governance — their names shall all be reported.
s0549.idiomatic: Those with especially distinguished achievements, as well as recluses hidden in hills and gardens whose talent is fit to assist governance — their names shall all be reported.

s0550.literal: " Ma He [some], vice director of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, and Li Chugong, pacification commissioner of Hedong — to the Two-Zhejiang and Jiang-East Circuit; Duolietu, surveillance commissioner of Jiangdong Circuit, and Qi Lüqian, director of the Astronomy Bureau — to the Jiangxi-Fujian Circuit; Julinbo, merit commissioner, and Meng Bi, pacification commissioner of Jinghu — to the Jiangnan-Huguang Circuit; Li Jianu, Minister of Rites, and Zhu Fen, Minister of Works — to the Henan-Jiangbei Circuit; Aijila, vice director of the Privy Council, and Cao Li, censor-in-chief — to the Yanshan-Shandong Circuit; Bietiemuer, crown prince tutor, and Han Rang, vice director of the Palace Provision Commission — to the Hedong-Shaanxi Circuit; Nahaqu and Dong Ne, Ministers of Personnel — to the Shanbei-Liaodong Circuit; Zhongjianu, Shaanxi salt transport commissioner, and Han Tingmao, central secretariat judicial officer — to Yunnan Province; Hanshi, Hunan pacification commissioner, and Liu Wen, Zaining Route prefect — to Gansu Province; Tushtemuer, Shandong pacification commissioner, and Lian Dun, left vice director of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat — to Sichuan Province; Tiemuerbuhua, Hanlin academy lecturer, and Wu Bingdao, secretary director — to the Capital Circuit.
s0550.idiomatic: " Ma He [some], vice director of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, and Li Chugong, pacification commissioner of Hedong — to the Two-Zhejiang and Jiang-East Circuit; Duolietu, surveillance commissioner of Jiangdong Circuit, and Qi Lüqian, director of the Astronomy Bureau — to the Jiangxi-Fujian Circuit; Julinbo, merit commissioner, and Meng Bi, pacification commissioner of Jinghu — to the Jiangnan-Huguang Circuit; Li Jianu, Minister of Rites, and Zhu Fen, Minister of Works — to the Henan-Jiangbei Circuit; Aijila, vice director of the Privy Council, and Cao Li, censor-in-chief — to the Yanshan-Shandong Circuit; Bietiemuer, crown prince tutor, and Han Rang, vice director of the Palace Provision Commission — to the Hedong-Shaanxi Circuit; Nahaqu and Dong Ne, Ministers of Personnel — to the Shanbei-Liaodong Circuit; Zhongjianu, Shaanxi salt transport commissioner, and Han Tingmao, central secretariat judicial officer — to Yunnan Province; Hanshi, Hunan pacification commissioner, and Liu Wen, Zaining Route prefect — to Gansu Province; Tushtemuer, Shandong pacification commissioner, and Lian Dun, left vice director of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat — to Sichuan Province; Tiemuerbuhua, Hanlin academy lecturer, and Wu Bingdao, secretary director — to the Capital Circuit.

s0551.literal: Because prefectures and counties suffered famine, an edict directed transporting one hundred fifty thousand shi of grain to store in riverside granaries for relief preparedness, and also directed officials to maintain charitable granaries.
s0551.idiomatic: Because prefectures and counties suffered famine, an edict directed transporting 150,000 shi of grain to store in riverside granaries for relief preparedness, and also directed officials to maintain charitable granaries.

s0552.literal: Brewing liquor was forbidden in Dadu, Shunde, Weihui, and nine other commanderies.
s0552.idiomatic: Brewing liquor was forbidden in Dadu, Shunde, Weihui, and 9 other commanderies.

s0553.literal: Wealthy commoners were recruited to contribute grain for official rank: two thousand shi for rank 7b, one thousand shi for rank 8a, five hundred shi for rank 8b, three hundred shi for rank 9a; those unwilling to serve would have their gates honored.
s0553.idiomatic: Wealthy commoners were recruited to contribute grain for official rank: 2,000 shi for rank 7b, 1,000 shi for rank 8a, 500 shi for rank 8b, 300 shi for rank 9a; those unwilling to serve would have their gates honored.

s0554.literal: Prince Waji dispatched an envoy presenting a gold pagoda.
s0554.idiomatic: Prince Waji dispatched an envoy presenting a gold pagoda.

s0555.literal: On jiyou day one million seven hundred thousand shi of Jiangnan grain was transported by sea to the capital.
s0555.idiomatic: On jiyou day 1,700,000 shi of Jiangnan grain was transported by sea to the capital.

s0556.literal: On gengxu day the Court of the Imperial Stud and Court of Imperial Entertainments were restored to rank 3a and granted silver seals.
s0556.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Court of the Imperial Stud and Court of Imperial Entertainments were restored to rank 3a and granted silver seals.

s0557.literal: On guichou day the imperial carriage arrived at Dadu.
s0557.idiomatic: On guichou day the imperial carriage arrived at Dadu.

s0558.literal: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea god Tianfei.
s0558.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea god Tianfei.

s0559.literal: On jiayin day famine victims forming pole-carrying societies was forbidden; those who injured others would receive one hundred strokes of the cane — enacted as statute.
s0559.idiomatic: On jiayin day famine victims forming pole-carrying societies was forbidden; those who injured others would receive 100 strokes of the cane — enacted as statute.

s0560.literal: On yimao day sacrifices were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0560.idiomatic: On yimao day sacrifices were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0561.literal: On jiwei day Cen Shixing memorialized that he had been clearly loyal and not rebellious, requesting appointment of Mongol and Han supervisory officials; an edict generously approved.
s0561.idiomatic: On jiwei day Cen Shixing memorialized that he had been clearly loyal and not rebellious, requesting appointment of Mongol and Han supervisory officials; an edict generously approved.

s0562.literal: On renxu day Prince Yaji presented horses.
s0562.idiomatic: On renxu day Prince Yaji presented horses.

s0563.literal: On dingchou day the Chenyudai River in Hejian was dredged.
s0563.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Chenyudai River in Hejian was dredged.

s0565.literal: Ministry of Rites vice director Yuan Yongzhen said, "Tieshi's regicide entirely originated with Tiemudie'er's initial wickedness; We request his crime be made clear and the record submitted to the Historiography Bureau, as a warning to subjects.
s0565.idiomatic: Ministry of Rites vice director Yuan Yongzhen said, "Tieshi's regicide entirely originated with Tiemudie'er's initial wickedness; We request his crime be made clear and the record submitted to the Historiography Bureau, as a warning to subjects.

s0566.literal: " Hanzhong Circuit's Wenzhou had continuous rain and mountain collapse.
s0566.idiomatic: Hanzhong Circuit's Wenzhou had continuous rain and mountain collapse.

s0567.literal: Tanchou had hail; three rivers in Kaiyuan Circuit overflowed; Qiongzhou, Nan'an, Deqing and other circuits suffered famine; grain and notes were granted in relief by rank.
s0567.idiomatic: Tanchou had hail; 3 rivers in Kaiyuan Circuit overflowed; Qiongzhou, Nan'an, Deqing and other circuits suffered famine; grain and notes were granted in relief by rank.

s0568.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wuyin new moon, Zhang Gui returned to Baoding to tend ancestral graves and, pleading illness, declined stipends — not approved.
s0568.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on wuyin new moon, Zhang Gui returned to Baoding to tend ancestral graves and, pleading illness, declined stipends — not approved.

s0569.literal: Cen Shixing and his son Temüer led forces raiding Shanglin and other prefectures; they were ordered to be summoned and instructed.
s0569.idiomatic: Cen Shixing and his son Temüer led forces raiding Shanglin and other prefectures; they were ordered to be summoned and instructed.

s0570.literal: On renwu day brewing liquor was forbidden in Chengdu Circuit.
s0570.idiomatic: On renwu day brewing liquor was forbidden in Chengdu Circuit.

s0571.literal: On guwei day Daolisha was appointed censor-in-chief.
s0571.idiomatic: On guwei day Daolisha was appointed censor-in-chief.

s0572.literal: On dinghai day sacrifices were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0572.idiomatic: On dinghai day sacrifices were offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0573.literal: On jichou day Prince Enping Tasibuhua's household was granted five thousand ingots of notes.
s0573.idiomatic: On jichou day Prince Enping Tasibuhua's household was granted 5,000 ingots of notes.

s0574.literal: On renchen day Mars transgressed Di.
s0574.idiomatic: On renchen day Mars transgressed Di.

s0575.literal: On guisi day Saturn, in retreat, transgressed Jing.
s0575.idiomatic: On guisi day Saturn, in retreat, transgressed Jing.

s0576.literal: Bozhou Kaili Miao led various stockade Miao and Liao to raid.
s0576.idiomatic: Bozhou Kaili Miao led various stockade Miao and Liao to raid.

s0577.literal: On yiwei day the empress Yilianzhenbala received Buddhist precepts from the Imperial Preceptor.
s0577.idiomatic: On yiwei day the empress Yilianzhenbala received Buddhist precepts from the Imperial Preceptor.

s0578.literal: On dingyou day Guangxi Yao chieftain He Tong submitted, requesting to serve in border defense — approved.
s0578.idiomatic: On dingyou day Guangxi Yao chieftain He Tong submitted, requesting to serve in border defense — approved.

s0579.literal: On yisi day Ningyuan prefect Tian Cha reported that Annam's native official Yana had attacked and plundered his Mumu stockades, requesting punishment; an edict directed the Annam heir to instruct Yana to return captives.
s0579.idiomatic: On yisi day Ningyuan prefect Tian Cha reported that Annam's native official Yana had attacked and plundered his Mumu stockades, requesting punishment; an edict directed the Annam heir to instruct Yana to return captives.

s0580.literal: On bingchen day Ningxia Circuit and counties subordinate to Caozhou suffered flooding; Bazhou and Quzhou Circuit suffered famine; two months' grain was granted in relief.
s0580.idiomatic: On bingchen day Ningxia Circuit and counties subordinate to Caozhou suffered flooding; Bazhou and Quzhou Circuit suffered famine; 2 months' grain was granted in relief.

s0581.literal: Eleventh month, on wushen day Prince Zhou Husseib sent an envoy presenting a leopard.
s0581.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on wushen day Prince Zhou Husseib sent an envoy presenting a leopard.

s0582.literal: Changning Army was changed to a prefecture.
s0582.idiomatic: Changning Army was changed to a prefecture.

s0583.literal: On gengxu day Xumaijie, because of annual famine, requested halting the empress's construction at Shangdu — approved.
s0583.idiomatic: On gengxu day Xumaijie, because of annual famine, requested halting the empress's construction at Shangdu — approved.

s0584.literal: Niuzhe, pleading illness, requested dismissal — not approved.
s0584.idiomatic: Niuzhe, pleading illness, requested dismissal — not approved.

s0585.literal: On bingchen day Guo Pusa et al. were executed, their associates beaten and banished.
s0585.idiomatic: On bingchen day Guo Pusa et al. were executed, their associates beaten and banished.

s0586.literal: On dingsi day the Emperor visited Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple, offered sacrifice to Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng at the portrait hall, and granted monks one thousand ingots of notes.
s0586.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Emperor visited Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple, offered sacrifice to Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng at the portrait hall, and granted monks 1,000 ingots of notes.

s0587.literal: Cen Shixing joined with Eight Circuits tribesman Ban Guangjin et al. to attack Shitou and other stockades; an edict directed mobilizing troops to defend.
s0587.idiomatic: Cen Shixing joined with Eight Circuits tribesman Ban Guangjin et al. to attack Shitou and other stockades; an edict directed mobilizing troops to defend.

s0588.literal: Officials of the Eight Circuits Pacification Commission were punished for lack of preparedness.
s0588.idiomatic: Officials of the Eight Circuits Pacification Commission were punished for lack of preparedness.

s0589.literal: On wuwu day Saturn, in retreat, transgressed the Battle-axe Star of the Jing constellation.
s0589.idiomatic: On wuwu day Saturn, in retreat, transgressed the Battle-axe Star of the Jing constellation.

s0590.literal: On jiwei day an edict directed rectifying the censorial framework.
s0590.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict directed rectifying the censorial framework.

s0591.literal: On gengshen day Japanese ships came for mutual trade.
s0591.idiomatic: On gengshen day Japanese ships came for mutual trade.

s0592.literal: Guangxi Circuit pacification commissioner captured Yao chieftain Pan Bao and imprisoned him; his younger brother Pan Jian then raided Liuzhou; Left Vice Director Qizhu of the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to capture them.
s0592.idiomatic: Guangxi Circuit pacification commissioner captured Yao chieftain Pan Bao and imprisoned him; his younger brother Pan Jian then raided Liuzhou; Left Vice Director Qizhu of the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to capture them.

s0593.literal: On renxu day an edict directed that for military and civilian officials inheriting by privilege, lineage charts of their native place were to be submitted for appointment through the selection process.
s0593.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict directed that for military and civilian officials inheriting by privilege, lineage charts of their native place were to be submitted for appointment through the selection process.

s0594.literal: On bingyin day Daolisha was again made left grand councillor of the central secretariat, with added title of Commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies and recorder of state affairs of military importance.
s0594.idiomatic: On bingyin day Daolisha was again made left grand councillor of the central secretariat, with added title of Commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies and recorder of state affairs of military importance.

s0595.literal: On dingmao day the Mengshan Silver Smelting Intendant Office was abolished and Ruizhou Circuit was ordered to oversee it.
s0595.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Mengshan Silver Smelting Intendant Office was abolished and Ruizhou Circuit was ordered to oversee it.

s0596.literal: On renshen day Prince Busaiyin was granted twenty thousand ingots of notes and one hundred bolts of silk.
s0596.idiomatic: On renshen day Prince Busaiyin was granted 20,000 ingots of notes and 100 bolts of silk.

s0597.literal: Prince Ordoe'erhan dispatched an envoy reporting pursuit of Guangxi Yao raiders; the Emperor said, "Since We ascended the throne, We have repeatedly issued edicts throughout the realm to pity and succor the common folk; only the Guangxi Yao have repeatedly rebelled, killing and plundering good people — therefore We ordered Ordoe'erhan et al. to suppress them.
s0597.idiomatic: Prince Ordoe'erhan dispatched an envoy reporting pursuit of Guangxi Yao raiders; the Emperor said, "Since We ascended the throne, We have repeatedly issued edicts throughout the realm to pity and succor the common folk; only the Guangxi Yao have repeatedly rebelled, killing and plundering good people — therefore We ordered Ordoe'erhan et al. to suppress them.

s0598.literal: Now We hear those welcoming submission are very numerous — they should further be placated with kindness.
s0598.idiomatic: Now We hear those welcoming submission are very numerous — they should further be placated with kindness.

s0599.literal: If they truly do not repent, strict troops should pursue and capture them.
s0599.idiomatic: If they truly do not repent, strict troops should pursue and capture them.

s0600.literal: " The capital suffered famine; four hundred thousand shi of grain was released for relief at reduced price.
s0600.idiomatic: The capital suffered famine; 400,000 shi of grain was released for relief at reduced price.
